chapter: The war years: Barnet, Hot Lips Page, Newton and Kirby
title: Missing the Grand Terrace job and the papers
summary: He ran to a closed Grand Terrace after oversleeping, got into the newspapers, and later returned to Chicago with Barnet.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: So you get back to Chicago again, do you?

Well, the next time I said, 'Look, the next time I hit this town...' Oh, to make things... The climax of this was when I made the papers. I came down, and the band had gone to the Grand Terrace, you know, and I gave the desk manager a shellacking for not waking me up on time. I run, I got a cab (?), went down to the Grand Terrace, and the white light was on -- it was closed or something. They
put me all in the papers: Piano player runs for job and the place was closed!
It couldn't pay the band. Couldn't pay nobody.

Anyway, the next time I came to Chicago was with Charlie Barnet later on. I'd go up to the old haunts. I didn't have as much fun as I did when I was broke! Because all the people I know, they weren't around or something. You know, it had a different look.
It sounds as though that was a good bunch of fellows you were with, with Lips Page.
Oh, that had a good thing going. The tops.
